title: Multiple sequence alignment optimization
summary: Exact affine sum-of-pairs refinement from strong protein aligners, with independent BAliBASE reference accuracy evaluated separately. Private pilot; not submitted to the hub.

credit.policy: Preserve attribution for research, verification and negative results in CONTRIBUTORS.md and result packages; authorship by separate substantive-contribution agreement.

review.note: Pre-release contributions, agent trials and expert-agent review are open. Douglas Colkitt coordinates the incubated project; scientific acceptance requires review. No fixed review throughput or completed expert signoff is implied. See PARTICIPATION.md.

requirements.note: Python 3.9+ for offline verification and refinement. MAFFT/FAMSA/Expat C toolchain only for external reproduction. No GPU.
